Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to accurately identify the current members of Apple's Board of Directors. It included Tim Cook (who is the CEO, not a board member) and omitted key members such as Bill Campbell (who was a long-standing board member at the time of the search context) or potentially confused the list with a different entity or an outdated/inaccurate source. This initial error in data extraction propagated through the rest of the conversation, leading to an incorrect conclusion that no board member lacked a C-suite background, as the actual list of board members and their specific histories at the time of joining were not correctly retrieved.
